claim.claim-text: 1. A system for facilitating treatment via a vascular wall defining a vascular true lumen (116) containing an occlusion (120) therein, the system comprising:
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the wings (3442A, 3442B) extend in substantially equal and opposite directions in a deployed configuration.
3. The system of any one of claims 1-2, wherein the inner shaft (3420) comprises a metallic tube (3422) with a solid proximal segment and a distal segment having a spiral cut (3424).
4. The system of claim 3, wherein the spiral cut (3424) terminates proximal of the side port (3425).
5. The system of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the cuts are made to define three hinge points (3443, 3444, 3445) per wing (3442A, 3442B).

6. The system of claim 5, the system configured such that by contracting the proximal end (3446) of the orienting element (3440) toward the distal end (3448) of the orienting element (3440), a proximal hinge (3445) and a distal hinge (3443) flex outwardly to extend each wing outwardly, with a center hinge (3444) at an apex of each wing.
7. The system of any one of claims 1-6, wherein the side port (3425) is oriented at a right angle to a plane of the orienting element (3440).
8. The system of any one of claims 1-7, wherein a distal portion of the inner shaft (3420) includes an inwardly inclined flap (3426) extending into the lumen of the inner shaft (3420).

9. The system of claim 8, wherein the flap (3426) is configured to direct a front loaded device toward the side port (3425) and permit a back loaded device to pass proximally through the lumen of the inner shaft (3420) while preventing back loaded devices from exiting the side port (3425).
10. The system of any one of claims 8-9, wherein the inner shaft (3420) includes a semicircular slot (3428) formed to accommodate an end of the flap (3426).

11. The system of any one of claims 1-10, further comprising a re-entry device (3600, 3610) having a distal tip configured to penetrate the vascular wall and enter into the vascular true lumen (116), the re-entry device (3600, 3610) sized and configured to be inserted into a lumen of the inner shaft (3420).
12. The system of claim 11, wherein the re-entry device (3610) includes a distally tapered shaft (3612) and a distal coil (3630) disposed over a distally tapered portion of the shaft (3612).
13. The system of any one of claims 11-12, wherein an abrasive tip (3620) is connected to a distal end of the shaft (3612).

14. The system of claim one of claim 1-13, further comprising an actuation mechanism (3460) configured to push the outer shaft (3410) and pull the inner shaft (3420) relative to each other to cause expansion of the orienting element (3440).

15. The system of claim 14, wherein the actuation mechanism (3460) includes a fixed handle (3462) fixedly connected to the outer shaft (3410), a rotatable handle (3464) rotatably connected to the inner shaft (3420), and a threaded shaft fixedly connected to rotatable handle (3464) that engages internal threads in the fixed handle (3462).
